exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. HD game color diffuse texture, edit existing painted UV image, preserve its exact artwork.

Image1 is the ENTIRE original opaque native storedRGB 128x128 enlarged4x with NEAREST sampling solely to show exact existing UV paint. It is the same full source canvas without any artwork changes. Output entire same aspect 128:128 canvas and normalized UV. Original fullalpha restored separately; keep all storedRGB including black authoredpaint. No margin/padding/crop/zoom/island registration/rotation, no layouts shifted.

Preserve the entire dark torso UV atlas exactly: three existing clipped pale circular/arced support marks along the upper edge; upper-center green-gray collar with the small original pale mark; central narrow vertical stack of subdued olive horizontal paint bands and original tiny pale vertical dotted tracks; long DARK RED-BROWN lower-center tab with its small old dark mark; broad nearly black folded side cloth fields, lower-right green-gray islands and exact black gaps. Keep every band count and little native mark, original softly faded local shadows and exact island boundaries. Preserve the actual red-brown tab hue, do not recolor it ochre. Avoid inventing shiny armor, metallic borders, extra hardware or new seams.

Keep original muted filtered hand-painted appearance, source brush softness, palette, relative local lightstrength and native scale. Gently resolve only existing low-resolution paint; keep all weak washes and small marks vague. Remove sampling steps without drawing new surfaces. Do not invent photographic weave, fibers, stipple, pores, metalgrain, raised rims, etching, shiny chrome, brighter white edges, new seams/buttons/straps/hardware, emblems or lettering. Preserve every existing dark gap, small mark, fold, count and phase. Do not brighten or sharpen weak diffuse washes into new structures. Increase resolution to four-times native dimensions while preserving source material and softness. No background texture added, no extraneous objects.
